'''Stealth pilots''' were highly advanced [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] who were chosen to test experimental [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] vessels during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Unidentified stealth pilot|one]] stealth pilot was assigned to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] as the co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of an experimental [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]].
